# Font settings

A font in Ink/Stitch's format keeps its settings in `font.json`, in the font's folder ([fonts](../../design/fonts.md#the-reader)). StitchCraft reads each key below as Ink/Stitch's lettering reads it, at Ink/Stitch's default where the file has none. Lengths are in the glyph files' pixels, 1/96 inch, and `size` in millimetres. A value of another type keeps the default, and [`SC-W1102`](diagnostics.md#sc-w1102) names it.

| Key | Takes | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | a text | `""` | The font's name, which lists of fonts show. Ink/Stitch's lists leave out a font without one. |
| `description` | a text | `""` | What the font is like. A key `description_` and a language code, such as `description_de`, gives it in that language. |
| `font_license` | a text | `"SIL Open Font License v1.1"` | The name of the font's licence, as its author wrote it. The font's licence file is what grants the rights. |
| `default_variant` | `ltr`, `rtl`, `ttb` or `btt`, or an older font's `→`, `←`, `↓` or `↑` | `"ltr"` | The direction lettering sews in unless it is told another. A font without glyph files for it sews in its first direction. |
| `text_direction` | `ltr` or `rtl` | `"ltr"` | Which way the font's script runs. Lettering reverses each line of a right-to-left font before it sets the glyphs. |
| `keywords` | a list of texts | `[]` | The categories lists of fonts sort the font into, such as `satin`, `sans_serif` and `tiny`. |
| `original_font` | a text | `""` | The font the embroidery font was made from. |
| `original_font_url` | a text | `""` | Where that font is published. |
| `leading` | a number | `100` | The distance from one line's baseline to the next, in the glyph files' pixels. |
| `auto_satin` | `true` or `false` | `true` | Whether lettering routes the text's satin columns and running stitches with auto-satin, in their order. |
| `scale_cross_stitch_pattern` | `true` or `false` | `false` | Whether lettering scales the grid of the font's cross stitch with the text. |
| `reversible` | `true` or `false` | `true` | Whether lettering may sew every other line in the reversed direction, back and forth. |
| `sortable` | `true` or `false` | `false` | Whether lettering may sort a multicolour font's colours, by its elements' `color_sort_index`. |
| `combine_at_sort_indices` | a list of integers | `[]` | The colour sort indices whose elements lettering joins into one element when it sorts the colours. |
| `letter_case` | `""`, `upper` or `lower` | `""` | Text set in capitals, in small letters, or as typed. |
| `default_glyph` | a text | `"�"` | The glyph lettering sews for a character the font lacks. A space leaves a space. |
| `size` | a number | `0` | The height of the font's reference capital at a scale of 100 %, in millimetres. |
| `min_scale` | a number | `1` | The least scale the font sews at, as a share of `size`: 0.5 is half as tall. |
| `max_scale` | a number | `1` | The greatest scale the font sews at, as a share of `size`. |
| `horiz_adv_x_default` | a number, or `null` | `null` | The advance of a glyph `horiz_adv_x` gives none, in pixels. With `null`, a glyph's advance is its right edge. |
| `horiz_adv_x_space` | a number | `20` | The advance of a space, in pixels. |
| `units_per_em` | a number, or `null` | `null` | The em of the font the glyphs were made from, in pixels. Ink/Stitch's font tools keep it, and lettering doesn't use it. |
| `horiz_adv_x` | an object of numbers | `{}` | The advance of each glyph that has one of its own, by the glyph's label, in pixels. |
| `kerning_pairs` | an object of numbers | `{}` | The kerning of each pair of glyphs, by their labels with a space between them, or joined in an older font, in pixels. It is taken off the second glyph's place. |
| `glyphs` | a list of texts | `[]` | The glyphs the font has, by their labels, as Ink/Stitch's font tools list them. Ink/Stitch's lettering offers the fonts that have every character typed. |
